mission.description: End-to-end SUAVE mission: default AVE aircraft, LEMD to HKJK at 6500 km, twelve segments of sixteen control points, with the resolved vehicle, the trained vortex-lattice tables and the segment schedule recorded as inputs

mission_segments.description: One iteration of a climb, a cruise and a descent segment at a fixed, unsolved unknown vector, recording every update method's output separately so a wrong step names itself

numerics.description: SUAVE Numerics defaults and the Chebyshev differentiation/integration operators, dimensionless and rescaled onto two segment durations.

profile.description: build_mission_request over four preset/route pairs: the mission half of the SUAVE mission request, checking field routing and the origin-to-destination tag.

vehicle.description: build_vehicle_request over two presets' full-analysis reports: the vehicle half of the SUAVE mission request, checking the cruise-thrust derivation, the engine/requirements blocks and the geometry and report passthroughs.

w64_provenance.description: W6.4 dual-runtime provenance and comparison checkpoints: the frozen Python reference-compatible mass coordinates feed the ALAS report/request, followed by the real SUAVE vehicle, mission solve, solver contract, inputs, geometry, and segment-level outputs. Product structural-wingbox CG corrections are tested separately without rewriting this reference evidence.
